scope: This refutes an extrapolation, not the fixed-fraction theorem or the global energy equivalence. The matching near-full order profile is now proved in near_full.txt; exact leading higher-m constants/optimizer geometry remain unresolved.
validation: Analytic counterexample internally reconstructed; finite matrix energy checks also passed.
